descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Kanvaz is an easy and satisfying paint-by-number experience designed for relaxation and short sessions.

Choose a template, follow highlighted zones, relax, and bring your masterpiece to life - no skill required.

Auto-correction system: your strokes snap perfectly into place - fast, effortless, and impossible to mess up (you can disable the auto-correction system to play without support if you want extra challenge).
[media]

Creative Freedom: you can still adapt the artworks to your own style
[media]

80-artworks pack, across a variety of themes
[media]

Relaxing environments: 5 different moods, and passthrough mode
[media]
